info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Update API allows businesses to modify existing loan applications identified by a unique parameter. This endpoint supports updating various attributes of the loan application, enabling financial institutions to maintain current and accurate loan records. Typical consumers include loan officers and backend systems that require adjustments to loan applications during processing. By streamlining the update process, organizations can enhance customer service and improve operational efficiency.

put.description: Updates the details of a specific loan application identified by its ID. This operation allows modifications to the loan application, enabling users to keep their information up to date.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating a loan application with the specified ID. It should contain all necessary information required to modify the existing application, including fields like applicant details, loan amount, and any pertinent updates or changes requested.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the loan application is updated.
